verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an agentic desktop AI app like Jan. The evidence shows on-demand autonomous tasks (jan-docs-13), agents that can manage calendars and act via messaging apps (jan-docs-14), browser automation via MCP (jan-docs-15), and a local API server. None of it mentions cron-style scheduling, recurring triggers, or timed workflows, and managing a user's calendar is not the same as scheduling jobs.
